# 07 — Design manual tests

## Objective
Create reviewable manual scenarios and exploratory charters for prioritised gaps.
## Required context and areas
Use recovered requirements, component map, risks, UI, and current automated tests.
## Change constraints
Test documentation only. Use synthetic data; do not duplicate automation without rationale.
## Response format
ID, objective, preconditions, data, steps, expected result, risk, trace links, cleanup, uncertainty; then charters.
## Assumptions
Do not invent expected results where policy conflicts; flag SME decision.
## Validation and evidence
Peer-check reproducibility and traceability; record validation commands actually run and reviewer decision.
